findings.description: F001 says a substrate plan opted in with no consumer journeys is advisory or warn, but the taxonomy and tests never pin a structured finding id or output shape for that warning. The user-facing outcome requires a surfaced warning, not just an internal posture enum.
findings.recommendation: Add a named advisory finding for the substrate opt-in/no-journey case, or explicitly reuse an existing finding, and assert its structured output shape in tests.

findings.description: F001 maps human_not_yet_typed_pending to consumer_outcome_pending at the generic per-journey layer, while the objective describes the D035 pending carve-out specifically for consumer=both. Without an explicit guard, a human-only journey with no structured human evidence could close as advisory instead of blocking as an unproven declared human outcome.
findings.recommendation: Constrain the not-yet-typed human pending carve-out to the intended consumer=both case with the enforced agent family satisfied, or explicitly expand the contract and tests if human-only pending is intended.
